description: A script that generates a diff between two JSON IDL files, comparing interface members and annotating differences.

methods.name: load_json_file
methods.description: Loads a JSON file into a dictionary.

methods.name: members_diff
methods.description: Creates a diff between two interface objects by annotating differences.

methods.name: annotate_all_members
methods.description: Adds a diff tag annotation to all members of an interface.

methods.name: interfaces_diff
methods.description: Compares two sets of interfaces and creates a diff with annotations.

methods.name: write_diff
methods.description: Writes the diff dictionary to a JSON file.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that orchestrates loading files, computing diff, and saving output.
